title: [29.X]Page cannot open because of FlowField 'Last Run By User'- #12304
summary: Fixed a page opening error caused by an invalid FlowField definition in the Financial Report table that referenced a non-existent user field.

Added test cases to verify the fix works across different localizations
Changes affect the Financial Reports page and Accounting Schedule Overview
